cases.name: polling-only source does not claim transient edge recovery
best-effort push source is only a wake hint, not replayable evidence
durable partitioned replay with adequate retention supports bounded recovery
durable replay with insufficient retention cannot claim the outage horizon
durable log without partition sequence and high watermark is not a complete cursor contract
signature without issuer-scope and key-revocation validation is not trusted provenance
current permission must be rechecked at the sink
unknown source capability fields fail closed
missing replay-retention value is not silently defaulted
push delivery with signed events but no durable replay cannot claim event recall
high watermark alone cannot qualify replay without stable source identity

limitations: Pure in-memory capability classifier; does not probe or authenticate a live source adapter.
Capability claims depend on the truth of the source profile supplied by an integration owner.
A source may change behavior after classification; production adapters need periodic conformance probes and signed capability/version receipts.
